Name: Pack Possum and Critter Cages - Trinkets
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=5][b]Pack Possum: At your Service[/b][/size]
Once you unlock the adventurer guild, you can hire the Pack Possum from the adventurer guild shop. Her fee is 3000 gold for 1 day (or 15000 gold for a week and 50000 gold for a whole season, after hiring her at least once). She can also be hired from the mines Dwarf and the volcano Dwarf later on, for the same price.

You do not need to have trinket slots/combat mastery unlocked to hire her, and she does not take up a trinket slot.

She shakes bushes and trees & collect forage into her pack for you, and you can put your things in her pack too.
[list]
[*]To view and manage her pack, press with the [font=Courier New]Open Tinker Inventory[/font] key (default RightAlt & OemPeriod, or LeftStick & ControllerX, set via TrinketTinker's GMCM).
[*]You can also talk to her with the [font=Courier New]Do Interact[/font] key, (default LeftAlt & MouseRight, or LeftStick & ControllerA, set via TrinketTinker's GMCM).
[*]If you left your things in her pack, she'll put them away in the lost and found for you.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Critter Cage: I heard you like trinkets so I put trinkets in a trinket[/b][/size]
When unequipped, the Critter Cage trinkets can be "used" (as though trying to eat food or read a book) to open an inventory that accepts more trinkets. Trinkets inside will be equipped whenever the Critter Cage trinket itself is equipped, and it works for both vanilla trinkets as well as TrinketTinker trinkets

These trinkets can be purchased at the desert trader, three tiers are available:

[list]
[*][b]Critter Cage (Iridium)[/b]: Holds 2 trinkets, costs 15 iridium bars
[*][b]Critter Cage (Radioactive)[/b]: Holds 4 trinkets, costs 5 radioactive bars
[*][b]Critter Cage (Prismatic)[/b]: Holds 6 trinkets, costs 15 prismatic shards
[/list]
If you lose a Critter Cage that has trinkets left inside, they will be sent to the lost and found.

[size=5][b]An Early Trinket Slot[/b][/size]
This is a "cheaty" option that allows you to have trinket slot unlocked ahead of Combat Mastery. When this option is on, trinkets may drop from monsters before Combat Mastery as well.

You can enable it in GMCM (default OFF), it takes 1 save/load to change. If you forgot your trinket when turning off this option, it takes another day before they will appear in the lost and found.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]TrinketTinker[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and extract to the Mods folder.
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3214]Wear More Rings[/url]: The second trinket slot can also equip a critter cage. (This is more of a note for the framework mod TrinketTinker)
[/list]

[*]English

[/list]
Additional translations are welcome, either on their own page or as part of the main mod.
